errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени във визуално низходящ ред по големина
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged in descending order of size, but this is not true for their visual layout on the pie chart. For example, the smallest slice (green, 9.1%) is positioned between the third largest (orange, 13.6%) and the largest (blue, 40.9%).
The description fails to mention the total number of responses (22 отговора), which is stated on the chart below the main question.
